style.backgroundSystem: only three background planes across the whole set: a seamless warm porcelain-ivory studio field #F6F1E7, a pale oatmeal panel #EAE0CE and a deep moss-olive field #3F4A2A, one dominant plane per screen with at most one hard horizontal edge where a wall plane meets a tile plane; no cool aqua or clinical mint wash, no gradient mesh, no sky, no marble, no leaf or botanical shadow cut-out, no weathered plaster wall texture, no dark low-key clinic room, no landscape scenery
style.iconSystem: single-weight hairline pictograms drawn directly onto the background plane with no box, chip, rounded square, ring, capsule or badge around them, always laid in one horizontal row of at most four above their caption line, deep moss-olive #5C6B3F marks on ivory #F6F1E7 and warm ivory #F6F1E7 marks on deep moss-olive #3F4A2A, pictograms stay icon-only and blank; numbered items use a small circled digit drawn in wheat gold #D9A75E; no bacteria, virus, microbe, cell or pathogen artwork, no cartoon germ mascot, no electron-microscope sphere, no flask, beaker, test-tube or microscope shape, no shield rosette, no dotted circle, no filled disc
style.lightingSystem: warm 4800K soft key from the upper left with a large warm ivory bounce card at the right, low to mid contrast, one gentle directional contact shadow that always falls to the lower right and grounds the pack, controlled soft highlight allowed only along the hinge edge of the oval flip-lid and the wet sheen of an exposed nonwoven sheet; never a cool clinical cast, never flat shadowless beauty light, never dramatic rim-only low-key

one neutral humanist sans-serif for headline and label placeholders only, deep charcoal-brown #2E2A24 lettering on ivory #F6F1E7 and warm ivory #F6F1E7 lettering on deep moss olive #3F4A2A, wheat gold #D9A75E hairlines as the only divider, no calligraphy, no serif, no handwriting; backgrounds limited to the ivory field #F6F1E7, the pale oatmeal panel #EAE0CE and the deep moss-olive field #3F4A2A, one dominant plane per screen, no gradient, no marble, no leaf or botanical shadow cut-out, no weathered plaster wall; surfaces limited to a matte porcelain-ivory tile #F1E9DB, a ribbed cream plaster block #EAE0CE, a brushed brass edge #C9A96A and a soft pale-sand low-pile mat #E4D8C3, no rattan, no straw, no wood board, no stainless shelving, no frosted glass riser; single-weight hairline pictograms drawn straight onto the plane with no box, chip, ring or badge, laid in one row of at most four above their caption, blank and icon-only, small circled digits drawn in wheat gold #D9A75E, no bacteria or microbe artwork, no microscope sphere, no flask or shield, no rounded-square icon chips; the pack always a sealed flow-wrap brick standing on its crimped base seam or laid on its back seam with the oval hinged flip-lid closed and its thumb notch at one consistent camera-left offset, its lid label a blank legible field in the reference position, never re-lettered and never redesigned, a wipe always rendered as an embossed cross-hatch nonwoven sheet and never as paper or tissue, product scale constant, every unit grounded by its own contact shadow; generous warm negative space; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no germ or microbe illustration, no concentration figure, percentage or test rate, no medical or skin indication, no hygiene-registration or certificate artwork, no food-contact or flame staging, no child in frame, no QR code or membership sticker.

no icon chips, rounded squares, rings or capsules around the pictograms
no warm wood, rattan, straw or steel staging

no infant, child, pregnant person or small hand in frame, and no toy, pacifier or baby bottle in frame

style.presentationRules: the pack is always a sealed flow-wrap brick shown either standing upright on its crimped base seam or laid flat on its back seam, with the oval hinged flip-lid on the top face closed and its thumb notch turned to one consistent camera-left offset, the crimped side flanges and the pleated end fins always intact, the printed lid panel kept a blank legible field in the reference position; a wipe is only ever rendered as an embossed cross-hatch nonwoven sheet, never as paper, tissue or a smooth pulp film; product scale constant across the set and every unit keeps a visible contact shadow; the pack is never re-sculpted, never swapped for a rigid tub, a pump bottle, a spray trigger or a slim sachet, never shown with the lid detached or the seal peeled open wider than one sheet; no percentage, badge or slogan is ever painted back onto the label
